name: Question 5
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,(P∧¬Q)⇒(P∨¬Q)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add columns for $¬Q,$ $P∧¬Q$ and $P∨¬Q:$

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬Q\,$ | $\,P∧¬Q\,$ | $\,P∨¬Q\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Now, we add a column for $(P∧¬Q)⇒(P∨¬Q).$ This statement is true unless $P∧¬Q$ is true and $P∨¬Q$ is false.

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬Q\,$ | $\,P∧¬Q\,$ | $\,P∨¬Q\,$ | $\,(P∧¬Q)⇒(P∨¬Q)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
